title: Saturday at the Supermarket
text:
Anna goes to the supermarket on Saturday. She has a shopping list in her hand. The list has milk, eggs, bread and apples. She takes a basket and starts to look for the food.

First, she finds the apples. They are red and very fresh. Then she goes to the dairy section and takes the milk. At the end, she pays for everything and goes home happy.

questions.text: Where does Anna go on Saturday?
Why does Anna have a shopping list?
options: To remember the things she needs to buy
To write a letter to a friend

questions.text: What can we infer about Anna's shopping trip?
options: She bought everything on her list
She did not buy any milk
She left the basket at home

vocabulary.definition: a large shop that sells food and other everyday things
a container you carry to put things in while you shop
new and not old or stale
a written set of things to remember or buy

paragraph_translations: Anna vai ao supermercado no sábado. Ela tem uma lista de compras na mão. A lista tem leite, ovos, pão e maçãs. Ela pega uma cesta e começa a procurar a comida.
Primeiro, ela encontra as maçãs. Elas são vermelhas e muito frescas. Depois, ela vai à seção de laticínios e pega o leite. No final, ela paga por tudo e volta para casa feliz.
